question: Choose the correct one-word substitution for: 'An act of deliberately burning a building or property.'
solution:
The correct answer is: **Arson**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Arson"** refers to the act of deliberately setting fire to a building or property, often for malicious reasons. (आगजनी)
 
 
• **Example:** The police arrested the man for committing arson after he set fire to the abandoned warehouse.
 
 
• **Explanation:** "Arson" is a criminal act and is punishable by law. It usually involves causing damage intentionally through fire. (आगजनी)
 
 
• **Example:** The insurance company refused to cover the damages because the fire was determined to be caused by arson.
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Arson**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Subversion** (विनाश या पलटना): The act of undermining or overthrowing a system, institution, or government. 
 
 
• **Example:** The rebel group was accused of subversion against the ruling government.
 
 
 
• **Burglary** (चोरी): The illegal entry into a building with the intent to commit a crime, typically theft. 
 
 
• **Example:** The burglar was caught after he broke into the house and stole valuable items.
 
 
 
• **Intrusion** (अतिक्रमण): The act of entering a place or situation where you are unwelcome or not permitted. 
 
 
• **Example:** The homeowner was annoyed by the intrusion of reporters into their private property.
 
 

38:T609,

The correct answer is** option 1.**
